attchmntText: S. P. Apparels Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
voiceSummary: S.P. Apparels Limited approved unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, during its Board Meeting on November 12, 2026. Consolidated revenue from operations for Q2FY27 was Rs. 4,522.2 million, showing 12.8% growth quarter-on-quarter. Half-year consolidated revenue stood at Rs. 8,532.9 million, up 2.7% year-on-year. Consolidated EBITDA for Q2FY27 was Rs. 666.5 million with a margin of 14.7%. Half-year EBITDA was Rs. 1,280.1 million with a margin of 15.0%. Consolidated profit after tax for Q2FY27 was Rs. 370.6 million, a 49.0% increase from the previous quarter. Half-year profit after tax was Rs. 619.3 million, up 11.9% year-on-year. Earnings per share for Q2FY27 were Rs. 14.7, while half-year EPS was Rs. 24.7. The results are subject to the Limited Review Report by statutory auditors.

voiceSummary: S. P. Apparels Limited has scheduled a conference call to discuss financial performance for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. The call is set for Monday, November 16, 2026, at 12.00 Noon IST. The event is organized by DAM Capital Advisors Ltd. Management speakers include Chairman and Managing Director Mr. P Sundararajan, Executive Director Mrs. S Latha, Joint Managing Directors Mrs. S Shantha and Mr. S Chenduran, Chief Executive Officer Mrs. PV Jeeva, and Chief Financial Officer Mr. V Balaji. Call leaders are Prerna Jhunjhunwala from DAM Capital Advisors Ltd. Dial-in numbers are plus 91 22 6280 1384 and plus 91 22 7115 8285. Participants are requested to dial in 5 to 10 minutes prior to the scheduled time.
